leanback.tagline: Your PC, now a couch console.
leanback.problem: Using a PC on the TV is clumsy: tiny text, a pointer you can't find, and a keyboard you don't want on your lap. Leanback Mode notices when you pick up a controller and rearranges Windows for the couch.
bullets: Switches to TV mode the moment your controller turns on, and back when it turns off
Bigger text and a pointer you can actually see from across the room
Sticks move and scroll, buttons click, go back and open Start
Steps aside on its own when you launch a game
Works with Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro, 8BitDo and generic Bluetooth or 2.4 GHz pads
leanback.alt: A TV showing large, couch-friendly Windows tiles and a big pointer, with a game controller in front of it

mediatabjump.tagline: Who's making that noise? Found it.
mediatabjump.problem: Thirty tabs open and something is playing. Windows shows you what is playing, but not where. Media Tab Jump makes the player in the volume flyout a shortcut straight to the right tab.
bullets: Click the now-playing card and land on the exact tab, even in another window
Works with Edge, Chrome, Brave, Firefox, Opera and Vivaldi
A soft, color-shifting glow tells you the card is clickable
Play, pause and skip buttons keep working like always
No browser extension, nothing to sign in to
mediatabjump.alt: The Windows volume flyout with a glowing now-playing card, and an arrow to the browser tab that is playing
